text:
[Council File 26-1419; CD 14]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT relative to stabilizing Single Room Occupancy (SRO) properties and preserving their long-term affordability to protect residents from displacement and prevent homelessness.
Recommendations for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Jurado – Hutt):
1. INSTRUCT the Housing Department (LAHD), in collaboration with Council District 14, Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles, and the Southern California Association of Nonprofit Housing, to report within 120 days, on a strategy to stabilize and preserve all SRO units located in Downtown Los Angeles that are subject to the City’s Residential Hotel Ordinance and the Development Guidelines for Residential Hotels in the City Center and Central Industrial Redevelopment Project areas.
2. INSTRUCT the LAHD, in consultation with the City Attorney, to report on the feasibility of entering into a sole-source contract with a qualified consultant to support the development of the preservation strategy with potential funding options, including but not limited to, Los Angeles County Affordable Housing Solutions Agency funds.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the CLA has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
